name: bizplug-florists
description: The florists & flower delivery plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: bouquets for pickup or delivery. It works from the business's own published profile, covering bouquets and prices, seasonal flowers, delivery areas, card messages and wedding and funeral flowers, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Never promise a delivery time, same-day delivery or an exact seasonal flower the florist has not confirmed; the florist confirms every order and may substitute flowers of the same style and value. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
